subject: NorthStar outage - service credit calculation and approval
messages:
From: Sam Keller <sam.keller@northstar.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Chen <tara.chen@northstar.ai>
Date: 2027-12-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: service credit for 2027-11-29 incident

Hi Ben,

We had a production interruption on 2027-11-29 that impacted inference traffic to our NorthStar models between ~02:10–06:40 UTC. Our telemetry shows roughly 4.5 hours of degraded or unavailable capacity across our primary region. Under section 6.2 of our SOW (monthly uptime SLA), we believe this qualifies for a service credit.

Could you:
- Confirm Redwood's assessment of eligibility
- Share the calculation you will use (formula + inputs)
- Provide an estimated credit amount and timeline for issuance

I attached our exported uptime slice for 11/29 for reference (uptime_report_20271130.csv). Also attaching the November invoice separately if helpful — happy to share that once requested.

Thanks — we need the number for our internal finance reconciliation and to share with procurement.

Sam Keller
Head of Platform Reliability
NorthStar AI

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Keller <sam.keller@northstar.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T13:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: service credit for 2027-11-29 incident

Sam — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the slice. We’re looking into it and I want to give you a clear, documented path to resolution. High-level:

1) Eligibility check
- Per our SLA (section 6.2) outages that reduce monthly uptime below 99.5% are eligible. We’ll compute the effective downtime minutes attributable to Redwood’s serving tier and compare to the monthly window.

2) Preliminary calculation (provisional)
- Inputs: reported degraded period ~4.5 hours (270 minutes), monthly interval = 30 days = 43,200 minutes.
- Raw downtime fraction = 270 / 43,200 = 0.00625 (0.625%)
- Contract credit formula = min( monthly_fee * downtime_fraction, cap 25% of monthly fee )
- If NorthStar’s November invoice is $134,400 (you can attach PDF), provisional credit = $134,400 * 0.00625 ≈ $840.

Note: I’m sending a working worksheet (credit_calc_v1.xlsx) with the above computations and a couple of alternate approaches (pro-rated token-usage and per-route weighting) — we typically reconcile token-weighted impact when customers have very skewed usage.

Next steps:
- Could you attach the November invoice (or confirm the bill amount) so we can produce a final number?
- I’ll sync with Finance (CC’ing Olga) and return a formal credit notice within 48 business hours once we confirm inputs.

We’ll also prepare an incident postmortem to include the root cause and mitigation steps; that will be shared with your SREs and procurement.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0187

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Keller <sam.keller@northstar.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-03T17:48:00Z
Subject: Final: service credit calculation and issuance timeline (NorthStar)

Sam — thanks for the invoice. Finance has reviewed and approved the credit as a billing adjustment. Summary below and attachments included: credit_notice_99512.pdf (formal notice) and incident_postmortem_northstar.pdf (root cause + mitigations).

Final calculation applied:
- Downtime attributable to Redwood: 270 minutes (4.5 hours)
- Monthly minutes: 43,200
- Downtime fraction: 270 / 43,200 = 0.00625 (0.625%)
- November invoice: $134,400
- Calculated credit: $134,400 * 0.00625 = $840.00
- Contract cap: 25% = $33,600 -> not hit
- Token-weighted adjustment: Not applied — agreed with NorthStar that the uniform fraction is appropriate for November

Issuance and timeline:
- Method: invoice line-item credit on December invoice (per NorthStar preference)
- Effective date: credit will appear on your 2027-12 invoice and be reflected in your portal billing summary within 10 business days.
- Contact for follow-up: Laura Bennett (Finance) — laura.bennett@redwood.com

We appreciate your patience. We’ve included the technical postmortem with remediation steps to avoid recurrence (KV cache eviction bug that surfaced under a rare scheduling edge case). If you’d like a quick run-through with our SREs, Olga can schedule a 30-minute call next week.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0187
